text: Article I. There shall be firm and universal peace between the United States of America and the Mexican Republic, and between their respective cities, towns, people, and citizens, without exception of places or persons. Don's, and all other authority, civil and military, shall cease to exercise any authority over the inhabitants of the territories ceded by Mexico to the United States. All hostilities by land and sea shall immediately cease between the two powers, and instructions to that effect shall be given to their respective commanders and officers. The ratification of the present treaty shall be exchanged at Washington, or at the seat of government of Mexico, within four months from the date of the signature hereof, or sooner if possible.
